description:
Please find attached a Request for Information (RFI) concerning an upcoming acquisition for Scaffolding Services in support of the Long-Baseline Neutrino Facility (LBNF) project.   

This RFI is in support of Fermilab's market research and acquisition planning efforts.   Interested vendors should respond per the instructions in the attached RFI.

This RFI is issued for information-gathering purposes only. Participation is voluntary and does not confer any advantage or disadvantage in any future procurement. This RFI does not commit the United States Government to pay any costs incurred in the preparation or submission of any response to procure any supplies or services
